overturned.item: §3.6 MIN_SKEW_IMPACT — value vs card 默认值
overturned.corrected_status: NOT_STATED (chain -5000000000000000 ×2 consistent with the card's own v0.3.1 参考值 and warning; no v0.3.2 expectation stated)
overturned.why: The card's 当前部署值 cell is '待本文按 market#1/#2 逐项回填/对账' (04:270), so there is no stated v0.3.2 value to fail against. The 默认值 cell (04:269) literally and correctly reports scripts/config/defaults.ts:58 and :84 (minSkewImpact: 0n) — it is not a wrong statement. But defaults.ts is never the effective source: configureMarket.ts::toMarketParams (lines 93-131) spreads baseDefaults and then overrides every MarketSpecificParams field from market.sample.json raw (minSkewImpact ← ratioToWeiPrecision(entry.raw.Skew_Clamp_Min), line 123). The chain value is exactly market.sample.json:44/:97 Skew_Clamp_Min "-0.005" × 1e18 = -5000000000000000, equals the card's v0.3.1 参考值 (04:271: 'min -5000000000000000 … 注意实际部署 min 为负，与 defaults.ts 样例不同，以链上为准'), and equals both v0.3.1 snapshots (tx-fork/260812 and base-sepolia/260729 MIN_SKEW_IMPACT market#1/#2 = -5000000000000000). Calling this a doc FAIL treats a non-operative defaults.ts note as an expectation the card itself disclaims.
overturned.evidence: 04-参数目录.md:269,270,271; defaults.ts:58,84; configureMarket.ts:93-131 (esp. 97-98, 123); configure-inputs/market.sample.json:44,97; parameters-by-module.csv 序号57-58 (-5000000000000000); TestCase/config/v0.3.1/tx-fork/260812 and base-sepolia/260729 MIN_SKEW_IMPACT market#1/#2 = -5000000000000000

overturned.corrected_status: NOT_STATED (no v0.3.2 source states an expectation; chain state equals what the archived inputs produce)
overturned.why: The facts are confirmed: 260812 STABLE_PRICE USDC = 1001000000000000000000000 (also set on base-sepolia/260729), v0.3.2 parameters.json STABLE_PRICE has 3 entries all unset, configureOracle.ts (read in full, 150 lines) never calls directKey.stablePrice (keys.ts:151-153), and ChainlinkPriceFeedProvider.sol:49-58 then uses min=max=feed price. But 'expected-but-unset' needs a stated expectation and there is none: STABLE_PRICE has 0 whole-word hits in 04, 0 rows in the v0.3.1 底本 CSV (grep count 0 — the 底本's 119 当前链上参数 rows never included it even though both v0.3.1 snapshots had it set), the catalog only defines the key, and no configure input carries it. overturned.item: caveat #6: 'the v0.3.1 260812 by-module file appears to have probed [the 4 raw FX100Keys] with abi.encode (EXECUTION_FEE_SUBSIDIZE* shown unset there)'

Under abi.encode hashing these would differ. Moreover LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD_BASE market#1 (same raw scheme, FX100Keys.sol:10) was found 已设置 = 900 in 260812 at key 0xe31f45769cf4c350e174a92df03363a73edaa60d8c8e3d68302785584246840c (= 序号116 key), which is impossible if the probe had used the wrong hash. base-sepolia/260729 also shows EXECUTION_FEE_SUBSIDIZE(_SIZE) 未设置 for all markets.
